`RpcAttributesGetter.getErrorType()` now supplies the final `error.type`. Returning `null` omits the attribute, even with an exception; the default still returns the exception class name.

Overrides that relied on extractor fallback can return the exception class directly:

```java
return protocolType != null
    ? protocolType
    : error == null ? null : error.getClass().getName();
```

Built-in getters retain protocol-code precedence and span-status behavior, including gRPC server non-error statuses with an exception. This is a breaking 3.0 contract change; RPC attribute-emission gating is unchanged.
metadata.title: Make RPC getters own final error.type classification
